transcript.text: By month 3 at SSV, you'll have more experience than most MBA graduates. And now, we're looking for the next 100 students. So years only, you would actually look like. So day 1, you're in the streets of Bangalore selling to real customers and negotiating with founders yourself. And 3 months later, you're building a DTC brand and scaling it to 50 lakh copies. And in 6 months, you're in front of Sequoia investors, pitching the scale that business even further. And whilst all of this is happening, you are being mentored by the top leaders in the country. From McKinsey, Zomato, Razor Bay and even Apple. So by the time you graduate, you won't be looking for a job. In their top start-up ceremonies, we'll come looking for you.
